title: Compute full matched-set report summaries from bounded snapshots
description: Customer chooses current-page or bounded all-matching-facts coverage for saved generic metrics/grouping/pivot. Enable all-match-total only for snapshot-capable authorized datasets after prior matched-set source contract proves complete <=1000 facts; never aggregate independently sampled pages or silently truncate. Existing current-page behavior/legacy GroupBy stays default. Use one request-scoped consistent snapshot for selected metrics, ordered composite dimensions and pivot: summaries must not change when display page/page size changes under identical facts. Reuse ERP-267/271/272 algorithms and exact checked decimal/null/known-count/currency/unit semantics; pivot grand averages from raw accumulators, not averages of cell averages. Source evidence count, matched count, rendered row count and scope/normalized-query/correlation/coverage appear prominently in preview and universal exports, never use 'all' if truncated or missing consistency. Internal authorized dependencies used for formulas/relations remain projected away; optional enrichment runs in snapshot and final fresh grant/menu/row/field checks deny revoked access. Formula aggregation and arbitrary joins remain unsupported unless separately proven; known metrics reuse business calculation values. Output groups/matrix <=200 rows/32 columns/1MiB and 30s deadlines; if fully matched grouping exceeds output bound return controlled reduce-range error rather than top-N masquerading as total. Persist coverage choice in draft/pinned version JSON, backward compatible old definitions, forbid requester scope/rows as authority. Workspace separates page facts from full-selection summary and clearly labels which totals follow each coverage. Offline fixture tests place facts outside display page and exercise mixed currency, nulls, overflow, shared scope and all-match cap/cancellation plus safe build/test. Never claim real transaction acceptance from mocked/in-memory tests. Stage 1 unified platform only; existing sales-order/receivable adapters are engine fixtures, not migration or new bespoke reports. Preserve old report entries until every fixed/dynamic report passes Stage 2 parity. No Agent or cross-business flow work. Server-authenticated identity and fresh existing menu/field/row/data scope remain authoritative, saved definitions/grants never grant ERP permissions. No arbitrary SQL, scripts, joins, tables, mixed currency/unit totals or one-to-many header duplication. No migrations, SchemaUpgrader/SeedData modifications, production SQL/database execution, schema/view/procedure changes, secrets/.env/config changes, deployment or irreversible operations. Use existing HTTP and entity audit conventions. Safe build/test and relevant offline integration tests required; missing actual DB/browser/font environment must be explicitly blocked, never claim the phase complete from build. Preserve unrelated source/work.
acceptance_criteria: Persisted coverage capability selects only supported bounded snapshot sources, rejects incomplete/overflow/untrusted whole-set requests and preserves old page definitions.
Generic metrics/composite groups/pivot derive from all <=1000 authorized snapshot facts with page-independent counts/nulls/currency partitions and strict output limits.
Preview UI and generic Excel/PDF distinguish displayed page from complete matched summary evidence; offline beyond-page/cap/permission tests and safe build/test pass.
